headline: ESDM Says Mandatory B50 Saves Foreign Exchange of Around Rp170 Trillion
summary: Indonesia's Energy Ministry said the mandatory B50 biodiesel programme saves around Rp170 trillion in foreign exchange. The statement came from the ministry's renewable energy director general, Eniya Listiani Dewi.
why: Biodiesel blending reduces imports of diesel fuel and supports demand for palm oil, linking energy policy to Indonesia's trade balance and currency.
